before.name: Variance Flag
before.description: Backend-set (issue #15) — true when |Amount Due - Calculated Total| exceeds the hybrid absolute/percentage tolerance. Computed once at invoice-creation time, after Invoice Items are linked so Calculated Total's rollup is current.

after.name: Totals Differ
after.description: Totals differ (#623; Variance Flag until then): true when Invoice Total and Calculated Total differ by more than half a cent (lib/variance.js:checkTotalsDiffer, #254). Backend-set: createInvoiceAction sets it once the invoice items are linked and Calculated Total has caught up, and updateInvoiceAction sets it again after an edit.

after.name: Has Price Variance
after.description: Price variance (#623): true when this item's Unit Price differs from its ordered item's by more than a cent (lib/variance.js:checkPriceVariance). Variance Flag until #623, when it held a quantity over the order as well; that half is Has Quantity Variance. Backend-set by createInvoiceAction, updateInvoiceAction and an overage correction's split.

after.name: Invoice Total
after.description: The total the vendor wrote on the invoice, typed in from it and never derived (#623; Amount Due until then). Compared against Calculated Total for Totals Differ. Whether the invoice has been paid is Paid Date's.
